qualified_prototype.changes: Wrapper extraction plus exposure of existing head.norm classifier-input tensor; unchanged model/operators. Shared A heads come from the existing grammar-a-baseline path dependency.

copied_source_files_requalified.scope: Optional MKL and FP64 numeric profiles and f64 trace output added to the copied sources; the FP32 graph passed the unchanged 41-case roster against the unchanged oracle (QUALIFICATION.md).

copied_source_files_requalified_rotary_t.scope: src/modernbert.rs builds each rotary angle as one float32 product (HF ModernBertRotaryEmbedding) and the FP64 profile (candle_f64_full_a_v2) widens the float32 cos/sin tables exactly. The FP32 graph's outputs are bit-identical on the unchanged 41-case roster against the unchanged oracle and on the three release reference cases; FP64 release-case errors fall (QUALIFICATION.md).

copied_source_files_requalified_span_tow.scope: src/modernbert.rs adds ModernBert::forward_with_branch (the hidden state entering a chosen layer with the encoder's masks, beside the unchanged final-norm states) and SpanTower (copies of the top layers with their own weights, attention kinds and rotary tables, then a copied final norm) for the spans-S2 span tower; forward is forward_with_branch without a branch. Warm-A roster (FP32 graph), the R0 release package (FP64 and FP32) and the shipped spans package (FP64, 15 synthetic and 200 local cases) are bit-identical against a build of main before the follow-up (72911dad), and every comparison passes with unchanged maxima (QUALIFICATION.md).

pytorch_layer_norm_port.copied_comment_relative_path: The preserved source comment points to its former sidecar evidence directory; the license is retained here at licenses/PYTORCH.

pytorch_2_9_1_numeric_profile.scope: Separate Linux CPU profile; same fitted weights and fixed gates. Six runs pass 44 fixed synthetic CUDA-reference cases each, including 2048-token and unsupported-input boundaries. Cloudflare serving remains unqualified.
